claims.explanation: UNC0321 is a picomolar EHMT2/G9a inhibitor whose cellular selectivity is likely driven by dependence on G9a/GLP-mediated H3K9me2 and p53-K373 methylation, so lines with intact p53 signaling and high EHMT2 expression are expected to be sensitized while p53-pathway loss or low EHMT2 expression protects. The observed enrichment of TP53 mutations in both sensitive and resistant lines suggests p53 status alone is not sufficient, and co-alterations in chromatin modifiers (ARID1A, KMT2D, KMT2C, SETD2) and RAS/PI3K pathway drivers may modulate the epigenetic dependency.

features.basis: target expression drives G9a inhibitor sensitivity
G9a methylates p53 K373; p53 loss reduces dependence on G9a-mediated p53 inactivation
ARID1A loss creates chromatin remodeling dependency enriched in sensitive lines
KMT2D loss alters H3K4/H3K9 methylation balance, enriched in sensitive lines
KMT2C loss alters chromatin methylation state, enriched in sensitive lines
SETD2 loss perturbs histone methylation crosstalk, seen in sensitive melanoma line
BRAF-mutant lines appear enriched among sensitive lines
PTEN loss/PI3K activation enriched in sensitive lines
NF1 loss/RAS activation enriched in sensitive lines
SMARCA4-mutant lines appear among less affected lines
ATM mutation enriched in resistant lines
VHL-mutant renal line 786O is resistant
